If your products are handmade and do not have barcodes, you can set the **identifier exists** setting to "no".

Here is what you need to know:

* Only use "no" when you are certain. If Google finds evidence that the product does have identifiers, the product gets a warning.

To fix the issue, update the identifier exists attribute to "no" for those handmade products.

For more details, see [Products that have no barcode (identifier exists)](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324478).
